Higher trust means earned media coverage carries real weight.
captions_meta.li_hook:
Trust in news in Singapore is 45%, the second highest of the six Asia-Pacific markets we work in, according to the Reuters Institute Digital News Report 2025.
That makes earned coverage especially valuable.
li_body: For comparison: Thailand 55%, Australia 43%, the Philippines 38%, Malaysia 37% and Indonesia 36%.
When audiences trust established media, being covered by it lends credibility that paid placements rarely match. Practical implications:
li_points: Invest in news value: data, clear impact, a named spokesperson.
Target the outlets your customers actually read.
Reuse coverage in sales decks, newsletters and social, with links to the source.
captions_meta.li_close: How does your team put earned coverage to work after it is published?
